contact_loss_diagnostic.interpretation: Movement during push is not the release-launch criterion. A shove may move early and stop after losing contact before scheduled release.

checks: separate property and per-shove RNG streams
physical properties used only by setup setter
state/action whitelist and raw-to-model transition alignment
same cube identities and non-cap nuisance settings as v3
caps uniformly remapped from2–4N to4–7N using unchanged random quantiles
all push steps retained; coast trimmed five steps after independently confirmed rest
trim removes only stationary steps; reported counts independently recomputed
actions exactly reconstructible from property-blind plans
full 3D transmitted force from pusher momentum
zero impulse from non-cube pusher proximity contacts
normal-only API projection agrees with momentum sensor
cap compliance and zero force after release
limitation: This is a data/physics audit, not the Oracle-vs-Plain prediction gate. Trimmed file length is outcome-dependent and must never be a model feature or label-revealing mask. No model training or added simulation.
